anchor: Large language models are served interactively, under explicit latency targets, from GPU fleets whose cost dominates the service's economics.
claim_text: The cost of GPU fleets dominates the economics of serving large language models interactively under explicit latency targets.

anchor: Serving systems decompose inference into stages of distinct computational character, each provisioned separately: prefill and decode run in dedicated worker pools
claim_text: Serving systems decompose inference into prefill and decode stages, each run in dedicated worker pools.

anchor: Multimodal models add one stage: a vision encoder converts the request's images into the embedding tokens the language model consumes, and modality-disaggregated architectures give that encoder a pool of its own
claim_text: Multimodal models add a vision encoder stage with its own pool.

anchor: Disaggregation makes each stage efficient, but it also multiplies the provisioning problem: a monolithic deployment asked one sizing question; a disaggregated one asks one per pool, continuously, under load that moves by the minute.
claim_text: Disaggregation multiplies the provisioning problem by requiring one sizing question per pool under load that changes by the minute.

anchor: This thesis studies how the pools of a modality-disaggregated multimodal serving system should be scaled, and defends a specific answer: each pool must be provisioned on its own demand signal
claim_text: Each pool in a modality-disaggregated multimodal serving system must be provisioned on its own demand signal.

anchor: In a production trace vision demand decouples from the request rate a conventional autoscaler watches, yet the burstiest signal is also the most persistent, forecastable zero-shot by pretrained time-series models
claim_text: Vision demand decouples from request rate and is the burstiest but most persistent signal, forecastable by pretrained time-series models.

anchor: A silicon-collected vision cost model composed with a calibrated simulation of the language pool reproduces the decoupling as saturation knees an order of magnitude apart
claim_text: A silicon-collected vision cost model and calibrated simulation reproduce decoupling as saturation knees an order of magnitude apart.

anchor: Per-pool provisioning holds the tail latency objective through burst onsets that defeat an identically informed reactive controller, at a fraction of the deployable static encoder fleet's GPU-time
claim_text: Per-pool provisioning holds tail latency objectives through burst onsets at a fraction of the deployable static encoder fleet's GPU-time.

anchor: Service quality is specified against this anatomy: bounds on time to first token (TTFT, dominated by queueing and prefill) and time per output token (TPOT, decode; reported here as the equivalent per-gap inter-token latency, ITL).
claim_text: Service quality is specified by bounds on TTFT (dominated by queueing and prefill) and TPOT (decode, reported as ITL).

anchor: Such bounds are service-level objectives (SLOs); following serving-systems usage, this document writes 'the evaluation SLA' for the specific tail bounds it grades every policy against, and SLO for the general concept.
claim_text: Service-level objectives (SLOs) are general bounds; the evaluation SLA refers to specific tail bounds graded against policies.

anchor: Meeting them economically on shared GPU fleets pushed serving from replicated monoliths toward disaggregation: prefill and decode in separate pools sized to their own bottlenecks
claim_text: Economically meeting SLOs on shared GPU fleets pushed serving toward disaggregation with prefill and decode in separate pools.

anchor: A multimodal request adds a third phase preceding both: a vision encoder, in current practice a Vision Transformer, ingests the request's images as grids of patches and emits embedding tokens.
claim_text: A multimodal request adds a vision encoder phase that ingests images as grids of patches and emits embedding tokens.

anchor: These properties invite modality disaggregation: run the encoder as its own pool, on its own hardware class, scaled independently.
claim_text: Modality disaggregation runs the encoder as its own pool on its own hardware class, scaled independently.

anchor: The prevailing practice, inherited from stateless web serving, is reactive: watch an aggregate load signal (request rate or a utilization average) and add or remove replicas at a threshold.
claim_text: The prevailing practice for scaling is reactive, watching an aggregate load signal and adding or removing replicas at a threshold.

anchor: Two assumptions hide in that loop — that the watched signal carries each pool's demand, and that new replicas arrive faster than the load changes.
claim_text: Reactive scaling assumes the watched signal carries each pool's demand and that new replicas arrive faster than load changes.

anchor: The second is optimistic for GPU serving, where bringing up a replica (scheduling, weight loading, warmup) takes tens of seconds to minutes
claim_text: Bringing up a GPU replica takes tens of seconds to minutes.

anchor: Prediction-driven capacity management has appeared for text-only LLM fleets — forecast-aware fleet planning, prewarming GPUs against forecast peak load — but watches aggregate, request-level signals
claim_text: Prediction-driven capacity management for text-only LLM fleets watches aggregate, request-level signals.

anchor: The empirical basis is AzureLMMInferenceDataset2025, the production trace Microsoft released with ModServe: one million requests over seven days of a multimodal inference cluster
claim_text: The empirical basis is AzureLMMInferenceDataset2025, a production trace of one million requests over seven days.

anchor: Exactly half the requests are text-only; image-bearing requests carry k×k grids, and the frames class of video-like requests (grids larger than 10×10, only 2.7% of all requests) accounts for 81.2% of all image volume.
claim_text: Half the requests are text-only; image-bearing requests have k×k grids; frames class (2.7% of requests) accounts for 81.2% of image volume.

anchor: The image signal is also an order of magnitude burstier, and its extremes do not co-occur with the request signal's: the week's largest burst drives image load to nearly sixteen times its weekly mean while the request rate barely moves
claim_text: The image signal is an order of magnitude burstier; the largest burst drives image load to nearly sixteen times its weekly mean while request rate barely moves.

anchor: Onsets ramp from baseline to peak in a median of six minutes; against replica cold starts of tens of seconds to minutes, a third of the bursts arrive too fast for a policy that waits to observe them.
claim_text: Onsets ramp from baseline to peak in a median of six minutes; a third of bursts arrive too fast for a reactive policy.

anchor: The image signal's long-range-dependence exponent is the strongest of the four (Hurst ≈0.93 versus 0.83 for requests).
claim_text: The image signal's Hurst exponent is ≈0.93, the strongest of the four signals.

anchor: The position this document defends, stated compactly: In a modality-disaggregated multimodal serving system, no single load signal can size every pool
claim_text: In a modality-disaggregated multimodal serving system, no single load signal can size every pool.

anchor: Each pool must therefore be provisioned on its own demand signal, and can be provisioned predictively, because the signal least visible to conventional autoscaling is also the most persistent: pretrained time-series models forecast it, zero-shot, at the horizons provisioning requires.
claim_text: Each pool must be provisioned on its own demand signal, which can be forecasted predictively by pretrained time-series models.

anchor: Scaling on these forecasts holds the tail latency objective through the burst onsets that defeat reactive control at every tested cold-start lead time and, over the evaluated week, at a fraction of the best static encoder fleet's GPU-hours
claim_text: Scaling on forecasts holds tail latency objectives through burst onsets at a fraction of the best static encoder fleet's GPU-hours.

anchor: The methodology is therefore trace-driven discrete-event simulation, the established instrument at this scale in LLM serving
claim_text: The methodology is trace-driven discrete-event simulation.

anchor: The platform prices each pool on the hardware class it targets. The vision pool is an event-driven FIFO of encoder workers costed by aiconfigurator (AIC), NVIDIA's offline planner, over performance data collected for this thesis on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090
claim_text: The vision pool is priced on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 using aiconfigurator.

anchor: The language pool is simulated by Dynamo's discrete-event engine under AIC-calibrated H100 timing
claim_text: The language pool is simulated by Dynamo's discrete-event engine under AIC-calibrated H100 timing.

anchor: The Qwen3-VL family's 8B, 32B, and 235B variants share one vision tower, so the calibrated encoder model and burst-saturation result transfer across the family
claim_text: The calibrated encoder model and burst-saturation result transfer across the Qwen3-VL family.

anchor: Forecasting uses three pretrained time-series foundation models (TimesFM-2.0, Chronos-2, and Toto-2.0) against naive, exponential-smoothing, and Holt--Winters baselines
claim_text: Forecasting uses three pretrained time-series foundation models against classical baselines.

anchor: A characterization of production multimodal inference traffic as per-pool demand signals
claim_text: Production multimodal inference traffic is characterized as per-pool demand signals.

anchor: A zero-shot benchmark of time-series foundation models on serving demand signals
claim_text: Time-series foundation models are benchmarked zero-shot on serving demand signals.

anchor: A silicon-calibrated cost model for consumer-GPU vision encoding
claim_text: A silicon-calibrated cost model for consumer-GPU vision encoding is developed.

anchor: A calibrated two-pool simulation platform, and the saturation-knee result
claim_text: A calibrated two-pool simulation platform is developed, showing saturation knees an order of magnitude apart.

anchor: Baselines and the closed predictive-scaling loop
claim_text: Baselines and a closed predictive-scaling loop are established.
